items.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Because I think probably Stanley Dance had something to do with it.

ctx.x: Yeah. He was out about two weeks. And I was working at Minton’s then I remember, and they called me up there, I was working with a small band. And they called me at Minton’s and they said Johnny was going to be sick. Because I think probably Stanley Dance had something to do with it. You know Stanley Dance, don’t you?
Yeah. So he’s the one that may have recommended you?
